axi_dma_rd.summary: AXI read DMA: an address FSM splits descriptors into 4K-safe AXI bursts, a read FSM shifts/aligns returned data and pushes it through a 32-entry output FIFO onto an AXI stream, then reports status.

blocks.name: AXI address controller
blocks.description: Accepts descriptors and issues 4K-safe AXI read bursts, tracking address and remaining length.

anchors.name: axi_state_reg
anchors.why: Address FSM: IDLE accepts descriptor, START issues AXI AR bursts until length exhausted.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_valid
anchors.why: Descriptor valid; with ready it loads address, length, tag into command registers.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_ready
anchors.why: Descriptor ready, asserted in idle when enabled and no pending command.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_addr
anchors.why: Descriptor start address loaded into addr_reg.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_len
anchors.why: Descriptor byte length loaded into op_word_count and cycle counts.

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Current read address, advanced by each burst size; checks 4K boundary.

anchors.name: op_word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes of descriptor; decremented per burst, decides more bursts.

anchors.name: tr_word_count_next
anchors.why: Per-burst byte count limited by max burst and 4K boundary; sets arlen.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-address valid; START state waits for it low before issuing next burst.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: AXI address ready clears arvalid.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Burst start address driven from addr_reg.

anchors.name: m_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Burst length computed from per-burst word count.

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Enables accepting new descriptors.

blocks.name: Internal command register
blocks.description: Holds per-descriptor offsets, cycle counts and tag passed from address FSM to read FSM.

anchors.name: axis_cmd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Internal command valid handing descriptor parameters from address FSM to read FSM.

anchors.name: axis_cmd_ready
anchors.why: Read FSM accepts internal command, clearing axis_cmd_valid.

anchors.name: axis_cmd_input_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Command register bank holding cycle counts, offsets, tag for read FSM.

blocks.name: Read data controller
blocks.description: Sequences AXI R beats, counts input/output cycles, generates tlast and descriptor status.

anchors.name: axis_state_reg
anchors.why: Read-data FSM: IDLE takes internal command, READ moves AXI R beats to stream and status.

anchors.name: input_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts remaining AXI input beats; ends input_active.

anchors.name: output_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts remaining output stream cycles; sets output_last_cycle.

anchors.name: input_active_reg
anchors.why: More AXI input beats expected; gates rready and counter updates.

anchors.name: output_active_reg
anchors.why: More output cycles pending; gates output counter decrement.

anchors.name: output_last_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Last output cycle: sets tlast, trims tkeep, emits status, returns to idle.

anchors.name: bubble_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Unaligned bubble cycle flag; disabled when ENABLE_UNALIGNED=0.

anchors.name: first_cycle_reg
anchors.why: First beat of transfer, used for unaligned bubble handling.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-data valid; with rready advances read counters and output.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Read-data ready, gated by output FIFO space and input_active.

anchors.name: m_axi_rresp
anchors.why: Read response captured on SLVERR/DECERR for status error.

anchors.name: rresp_reg
anchors.why: Sticky AXI error response accumulated across the transfer.

anchors.name: tag_reg
anchors.why: Descriptor tag held for status output.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_desc_status_valid
anchors.why: One-cycle status pulse when the last output cycle of a descriptor completes.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_desc_status_error
anchors.why: Error code derived from accumulated AXI read response.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_desc_status_tag
anchors.why: Echoes descriptor tag with status.

blocks.name: Read data alignment
blocks.description: Shifts AXI read data by byte offset and forms internal stream beats with tkeep/tlast.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data, saved and shifted to form stream data.

anchors.name: save_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Previous AXI read beat saved for cross-beat shifting.

anchors.name: transfer_in_save
anchors.why: Load enable for save_axi_rdata_reg on accepted beat.

anchors.name: shift_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Aligned read data from current and saved beats shifted by offset.

anchors.name: offset_reg
anchors.why: Byte offset selecting shift amount for read data alignment.

anchors.name: last_cycle_offset_reg
anchors.why: Byte count of final cycle used to trim tkeep.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal stream valid; write enable into output FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tready_int
anchors.why: Internal ready from FIFO not half full; throttles rready.

blocks.name: Output FIFO
blocks.description: 32-entry stream FIFO with output register driving the AXI stream master.

anchors.name: out_fifo_tdata
anchors.why: 32-entry output FIFO data array buffering stream beats.

anchors.name: out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO write pointer, increments on internal valid when not full.

anchors.name: out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO read pointer, increments when output register loads.

anchors.name: out_fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: FIFO half-full flag backpressures internal ready.

anchors.name: out_fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full blocks writes.

anchors.name: out_fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty blocks output register load.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream data read from output FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid from FIFO output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready pops output FIFO into output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tlast
anchors.why: Marks last beat of descriptor frame.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte keep, trimmed on last cycle by last_cycle_offset.

axi_dma_wr.summary: AXI-stream to AXI4 write DMA: a 5-state FSM splits descriptors into 4K-safe bursts, aligns stream data, buffers beats in an output FIFO and reports completion via a status FIFO.

blocks.name: Write DMA controller
blocks.description: FSM sequencing descriptor load, burst issue, data beats, burst finish and drop.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM (IDLE/START/WRITE/FINISH_BURST/DROP_DATA) sequencing descriptor, bursts and data.

anchors.name: input_active_reg
anchors.why: Input stream still delivering data for this burst; gates tready and counters.

anchors.name: last_transfer_reg
anchors.why: Current burst is final of descriptor; controls tready and finish path.

anchors.name: output_last_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Last beat of AXI burst; asserts WLAST and state exit.

anchors.name: first_cycle_reg
anchors.why: First cycle of descriptor; adjusts length and AW issue condition.

anchors.name: transfer_in_save
anchors.why: Load enable for saved stream word used by alignment shifter.

anchors.name: flush_save
anchors.why: Clears saved partial word and extra-cycle flag in IDLE.

anchors.name: status_fifo_we
anchors.why: Enqueue enable for status FIFO at burst end.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid_int
anchors.why: FSM beat write enable into output FIFO.

blocks.name: Descriptor and burst address generator
blocks.description: Accepts descriptors, splits into 4K-safe bursts and drives AXI AW channel.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_valid
anchors.why: Write descriptor valid; accepted in IDLE to start a DMA operation.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_ready
anchors.why: Descriptor ready, asserted in IDLE when enabled and status slots available.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_addr
anchors.why: Descriptor start address loaded into addr_reg.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_len
anchors.why: Descriptor length loaded into op_word_count_reg.

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Global enable gating descriptor acceptance.

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Current write address; advanced by burst size after each AW issue.

anchors.name: op_word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes of descriptor; decides burst size and more bursts.

anchors.name: tr_word_count_next
anchors.why: Computed burst byte count limited by max burst and 4K boundary.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid issued per burst in START state.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Burst start address loaded from addr_reg.

anchors.name: m_axi_awlen
anchors.why: Burst length from output cycle count.

anchors.name: m_axi_awready
anchors.why: AXI AW ready clearing awvalid.

anchors.name: tag_reg
anchors.why: Descriptor tag held for status FIFO entries.

blocks.name: Beat and length counters
blocks.description: Input/output cycle counters and accumulated length per burst.

anchors.name: input_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining input stream cycles in current burst.

anchors.name: output_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining AXI beats in current burst; sets output_last_cycle.

anchors.name: length_reg
anchors.why: Accumulated transferred byte length reported in status.

blocks.name: Stream alignment shifter
blocks.description: Combines saved and incoming stream words to realign data to AXI address offset.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_data_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream payload, shifted for alignment and written to AXI.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid; triggers first AW issue and data beats.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_data_tready
anchors.why: Input stream ready computed by FSM from FIFO space and active flags.

anchors.name: shift_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Aligned stream data combining saved and new words by offset.

anchors.name: shift_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Aligned data valid gating FSM beat processing.

anchors.name: shift_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Aligned end-of-packet; triggers status enqueue and state exit.

anchors.name: shift_axis_input_tready
anchors.why: Shifter can accept input; gates stream tready.

anchors.name: save_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Saved previous stream word for unaligned shift.

anchors.name: shift_axis_extra_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Extra output cycle needed to flush saved bytes at frame end.

anchors.name: offset_reg
anchors.why: Byte offset selecting shift amount for unaligned data.

anchors.name: zero_offset_reg
anchors.why: Selects passthrough vs shifted stream path.

blocks.name: Output write data FIFO
blocks.description: 32-entry FIFO buffering W beats with half-full backpressure to FSM.

anchors.name: out_fifo_wdata
anchors.why: Output write-data FIFO decoupling FSM beats from AXI W channel.

anchors.name: out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO write pointer, increments on m_axi_wvalid_int.

anchors.name: out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO read pointer, increments when W beat loaded.

anchors.name: out_fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO half-full; deasserts internal write ready.

anchors.name: m_axi_wready_int
anchors.why: Internal ready from output FIFO back-pressuring FSM data beats.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data driven from output FIFO register.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid from output FIFO read side.

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: AXI W ready; pops output FIFO into W registers.

blocks.name: Completion status FIFO
blocks.description: Queues per-burst status, pops on B responses and emits descriptor status with errors.

anchors.name: status_fifo_len
anchors.why: Status FIFO memory of per-burst length (with tag/id/dest/user/last arrays).

anchors.name: status_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Status FIFO write pointer, advanced when burst status enqueued.

anchors.name: status_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Status FIFO read pointer, advanced on each B response.

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI write response valid; pops status FIFO and reports completion.

anchors.name: m_axi_bready
anchors.why: B ready asserted while status FIFO has pending entries.

anchors.name: bresp_reg
anchors.why: Sticky AXI error response mapped to status error code.

anchors.name: m_axis_write_desc_status_valid
anchors.why: Descriptor completion status valid, from last flag of status FIFO entry.

anchors.name: m_axis_write_desc_status_error
anchors.why: DMA error code from AXI SLVERR/DECERR responses.

anchors.name: m_axis_write_desc_status_len
anchors.why: Reported transferred length from status FIFO.

anchors.name: active_count_reg
anchors.why: Outstanding burst count limiting in-flight writes to status FIFO depth.

anchors.name: active_count_av_reg
anchors.why: Outstanding slot available; gates descriptor ready and AW issue.

axi_dma.summary: AXI4 DMA top: a structural wrapper pairing an independent read DMA (AXI memory to AXI stream) and write DMA (AXI stream to AXI memory), each driven by descriptor inputs and reporting status.

blocks.name: Read DMA engine
blocks.description: axi_dma_rd child: descriptors to AXI read bursts, returned data to AXI stream.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_valid
anchors.why: Read descriptor submit into read DMA child.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_addr
anchors.why: Source memory address of read descriptor.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tdata
anchors.why: AXI stream output of data read from memory.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Read data stream valid from read DMA.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI master read burst address from read DMA.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI master read data returned to read DMA.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_desc_status_valid
anchors.why: Read descriptor completion status pulse.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid from read DMA.

anchors.name: read_enable
anchors.why: Enables read DMA descriptor processing.

blocks.name: Write DMA engine
blocks.description: axi_dma_wr child: AXI stream data written to memory as AXI write bursts.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_valid
anchors.why: Write descriptor submit into write DMA child.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_addr
anchors.why: Destination memory address of write descriptor.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_data_tdata
anchors.why: AXI stream input data written to memory.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI master write burst address from write DMA.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI master write data from write DMA.

anchors.name: m_axis_write_desc_status_valid
anchors.why: Write descriptor completion status pulse.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Write data stream valid into write DMA.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid from write DMA.

anchors.name: write_enable
anchors.why: Enables write DMA descriptor processing.

anchors.name: write_abort
anchors.why: Aborts the current write DMA transfer.
